definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese name for July (the seventh month). Part of the set of twelve traditional month names (和風月名) that predate the adoption of the Western calendar. Still used in formal writing, poetry, and seasonal greetings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{七月|しちがつ}→七月：00667_shichigatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文月|ふづき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書|か}き{出|だ}し→書き出し：19293_kakidashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{文月|ふづき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{候|こう}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote 'in the season of fumizuki' at the beginning of the letter.

notes:
The name {文月|ふづき} is thought to derive from the custom of writing poems and letters during the Tanabata festival (⟦{七夕|たなばた}→七夕：05633_tanabata⟧) in the seventh month. {文|ふみ} means "letter" or "writing."

The twelve traditional month names are:
⟦{睦月|むつき}→睦月：18674_mutsuki⟧ (Jan), ⟦{如月|きさらぎ}→如月：20361_kisaragi⟧ (Feb), ⟦{弥生|やよい}→弥生：20353_yayoi⟧ (Mar), {卯月|うづき} (Apr), {皐月|さつき} (May), ⟦{水無月|みなづき}→水無月：21764_minazuki⟧ (Jun), {文月|ふづき} (Jul), ⟦{葉月|はづき}→葉月：22859_hazuki⟧ (Aug), {長月|ながつき} (Sep), ⟦{神無月|かんなづき}→神無月：20362_kannazuki⟧ (Oct), {霜月|しもつき} (Nov), ⟦{師走|しわす}→師走：16153_shiwasu⟧ (Dec).
